commands.text: A person walks forward, turns to the left, and continues walking.
commands.text_zh: 先向前走，再向左转身，随后继续向前走。

commands.text: A person raises both arms above the head, bends forward, and returns upright.
commands.text_zh: 先把双臂举过头顶，再向前弯腰，最后恢复直立。

commands.text: A person takes a step backward, squats down, and stands up.
commands.text_zh: 先向后退一步，再蹲下，最后站起来。

commands.text: A person jogs forward, slows down, and stops with arms relaxed.
commands.text_zh: 先向前慢跑，再逐渐减速，最后放松双臂停下。

surface.outlier_interpolation: SO(3) interpolation of fitted local rotations between nearest non-outlier fits, then bounds; original source joints unchanged

language: Chinese instructions are displayed with the English translations actually supplied to SALAD and the streaming model; not a native Chinese-language model evaluation.
scope: Selected qualitative demonstration, separate from all frozen benchmarks

presentation.selection: First two consecutive complete targets from the same four-instruction recording; an uncut temporal prefix, no within-action editing or speed changes. Subsequent candidates are retained in the full recording but are not selected as semantic showcase cases.

instruction_labels: Latest issued instruction; queued history may precede current target readiness and entry.
